name: Turkey and Veg Soup
method: Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the chopped onion and carrot for 4 minutes. Add the turkey mince and fry for 5 minutes, breaking it up, until browned.
Stir in the cumin for 1 minute, then add the passata and 300ml water and bring to the boil.
Simmer for 15 minutes until the turkey is cooked through and the carrot is tender. Season with salt and pepper.
Ladle into a bowl and serve hot.
